source: MAFF Department of Agricultural Extension / ASPIRE Project, IFAD-funded - "បច្ចេកទេសដាំដុះក្រូចថ្លុងដែលធន់ទៅនឹងការប្រែប្រួលអាកាសធាតុ / Climate Resilience Pomelo Growing Technique", Nov 2018, 17pp
text: Newly planted trees are watered regularly during establishment (ការថែទាំ), especially in the dry season, and are protected from strong sun and wind while their root systems are still small. The guide recommends checking soil moisture around the root zone regularly rather than watering on a fixed schedule, since over-watering in poorly drained spots can be as damaging as under-watering during dry spells.
